findings.summary: Snapshot preservation depends on the current driver exposing restore; otherwise _load_cont discards the stored snapshot and a kernel-only save overwrites it (reproduced: StatefulDriver run restarted with NotesDriver, cancel -> stored snapshot null).
Drop-log sanitization treats every numeric token as an array index, so an undeclared numeric dictionary key reaches context.assembled and the evidence bundle (reproduced: ev-r1#/by_id/123456789).
